LESSON: OBSERVING AND ARTICULATING SIGNS 6.1.2. REPORTING SKILLS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.1: Observing and articulating signs 6.1.2. Reporting skills
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Observing and articulating signs 6.1.2. Reporting skills, part of Strand 6 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: How is the weather today? 2. Which clothes do we wear on a rainy day?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Observing and articulating signs 6.1.2. Reporting skills together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
92

● Critical thinking and Problem solving: reflection skills as learner takes a nature walk and acquires more knowledge

about the environment.

● Communication and Collaboration: observation and signing skills as learner role plays a rainy day carrying umbrellas

and getting feedback from the others.

Values:
● Responsibility: hard work as learner practices covering self with an umbrella when it is raining within the role play.

● Unity: cooperation as learner take turns to report observation findings after the nature walk and as they role play.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Tolerance as leaner walks around during the nature walk to observe weather.

Link to other Activity Areas:

Environmental Activities as the learner observes weather during the nature walk and role plays use of umbrella on a

rainy day.

Suggested Learning Resources: Adapted course books, signed audio visual clips, books, Flash cards, charts, pictures,
